cells_owed.law: EVERY PRODUCER OWES CELLS (LAWS 7). An organ that runs on a clock, consumes compute and emits no cell inside its own window is a defect with an owner. Exploratory organs pass by DECLARING what they produce instead and who reads it. Ratchets fall only; nothing here caps a producer.
